summary: First-run backend testing for Boxing Gym FastAPI. Covered auth (login/me/401), public endpoints (settings/products/packages/events/contact), full admin CRUD for products/packages/subscribers/events/messages, progress + media for subscribers, payments (monthly next_due_date computation + overdue/expiring_soon/valid status), packages analytics, admin settings update + persistence, dashboard metrics, and Stripe checkout (session creation + status polling). 23/23 tests passed (100%).

minor.issue: When the body omits required fields after a 404 path, FastAPI returns 422 instead of 404. Not a real bug but contract is ambiguous. Cosmetic.
When no monthly payment exists, payment_status returns 'unknown' (not part of declared green/yellow/red palette). Frontend must handle this 4th state for new subscribers.

allow_origins='*' combined with allow_credentials=True violates the CORS spec (browsers will reject credentialed requests). Currently frontend uses Bearer header so it works, but cookie-based auth would silently fail. Recommend explicit origin list when credentials are enabled.

action_items: Optional: tighten CORS allow_origins to explicit origins since allow_credentials=True (current '*' is spec-violating, but harmless with header-based JWT).
Optional: document the 'unknown' payment_status (used when subscriber has no monthly payment) so frontend can render a neutral color.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~880 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth/products/packages/subscribers/payments/events/messages/dashboard/stripe) for maintainability.
Admin endpoints validate auth via Depends(get_current_user) but never enforce role=='admin'. Any future non-admin user would be able to access admin routes. Add a role check helper.

PUT endpoints (products/packages/events/subscribers) accept the *In Pydantic models which require all fields; partial updates aren't supported. Consider using Optional fields or a separate Update model.
compute_next_due / calc_payment_status are timezone-aware which is good, but parse_dt silently returns None for malformed strings — DB writes don't validate ISO format end-to-end.
Dashboard endpoint loads up to 50k payments in memory for aggregation; consider Mongo aggregation pipeline for scalability.
Stripe webhook does not verify HMAC signature beyond what emergentintegrations does; ensure that library validates Stripe-Signature.
test_credentials: admin@boxinggym.com / admin123 (works; seed_admin re-syncs hash on startup).
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed products/packages/subscribers/events/payments/messages and clean them up via fixtures/teardown.
